missions.name: LEARN THE INTERSECTION
missions.subtitle: PHASE SWITCHING & CLEARANCE DELAYS
missions.objective: Operate the traffic signals. Maintain safe transitions (Yellow and All-Red intervals) and keep traffic flowing smoothly.

missions.name: MANAGE THE TRAFFIC
missions.subtitle: QUEUE BALANCING & CONGESTION
missions.objective: Traffic volume is increasing from the East avenue! Monitor queue build-up and prevent congestion from hitting Critical levels.

missions.name: PEDESTRIAN PRIORITY
missions.subtitle: SAFE CROSSINGS & ALL-RED WALK
missions.objective: Pedestrian groups are waiting at zebra crossings. Switch to Pedestrian Walk [P] to allow safe crossing without causing gridlock.

missions.name: EMERGENCY PRIORITY
missions.subtitle: AMBULANCE ROUTE CLEARANCE
missions.objective: Emergency vehicles are approaching! Identify their direction, switch signals to grant an open corridor, and resume normal flow.

missions.name: RUSH HOUR
missions.subtitle: THE ULTIMATE TRAFFIC CHALLENGE
missions.objective: Peak rush hour! Manage dense multi-lane traffic, pedestrian crowds, and emergency ambulances. Maintain high safety and flow scores.
